title: Cancellation Windows and Charges by Service Level
content:
# Conditions of the Work Order: Cancellation Windows and Charges

If you decide against work you have already authorised on a piece at the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service, your service level sets a window, counted in hours from the authorisation, inside which the order may be called off without charge, and the charge that applies afterwards.

| Service level | Cancellation window, hours from the authorisation | Cancellation charge after the window, USD |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Bench Service | 24 | 0.00 |
| Priority Bench Service | 24 | 25.00 |
| Master Jeweler Service | 48 | 45.00 |
| Heritage Restoration Service | 72 | 95.00 |
| Designer Authorized Repair Service | 72 | 125.00 |
| Atelier White-Glove Service | 24 | 250.00 |

## Conditions

1. The window runs in hours from the authorisation: 24 hours at Standard Bench Service, Priority Bench Service and Atelier White-Glove Service, 48 hours at Master Jeweler Service, 72 hours at Heritage Restoration Service and Designer Authorized Repair Service.
2. Inside the window the order is called off without charge. Afterwards the level's cancellation charge stands: 0.00 USD at Standard Bench Service, rising to 250.00 USD at Atelier White-Glove Service.

## Boundary cases

A hypothetical Master Jeweler Service order authorised at the counter and called off 47 hours later falls inside the level's 48-hour window and carries no charge. The same order called off 49 hours after the authorisation falls outside the window and carries the level's charge of 45.00 USD. A hypothetical Standard Bench Service order called off outside its 24-hour window carries that level's charge of 0.00 USD.
